name: google-cloud-cli

patches.new:
promptWithDefault() {
  if [ -n "${CLOUDSDK_CORE_DISABLE_PROMPTS:-}" ]; then
    printf -v "$3" '%s' "$2"
    return
  fi

actual_installer_sha=$(sha256sum "$destination/install.sh" | awk '{print $1}')
  [ "$actual_installer_sha" = "db69ff9ac4c55c8b18c1041b717ba1370e4d921ace4d67c05088d4411d75282a" ] || { echo "Archive installer source changed" >&2; return 1; }
  mkdir -p "$destination/offline"
  offline_fetch "https://dl.google.com/dl/cloudsdk/channels/rapid/components-v592.0.0.json" "$destination/offline/components-v592.0.0.json"
  trace "$destination/install.sh" --quiet --usage-reporting=false --command-completion=true --path-update=true --rc-path="$HOME/.bashrc"

resources.checksum_source: local SHA-256 pin after official HTTPS download
local SHA-256 pin after official versioned snapshot download

smoke:
. "$HOME/.bashrc"
test "$(command -v gcloud)" = "$OFFLINE_PREFIX/google-cloud-sdk/bin/gcloud"
complete -p gcloud > /tmp/gcloud-completion.txt
grep -q _python_argcomplete /tmp/gcloud-completion.txt
"$OFFLINE_PREFIX/google-cloud-sdk/platform/bundledpythonunix/bin/python3" -c 'import sys, ssl, sqlite3; assert sys.version_info[:2] == (3, 14); print(sys.version.split()[0])'
bq version
gsutil version
d=$(mktemp -d)
export CLOUDSDK_CONFIG="$d/config"
gcloud config configurations create offline --activate --quiet
gcloud config set core/project shellferry-offline --quiet
gcloud config set core/verbosity warning --quiet
test "$(gcloud config get-value core/project)" = shellferry-offline
test "$(gcloud config get-value core/verbosity)" = warning
gcloud components list --only-local-state --format='value(id)' > "$d/components"
grep -Fx core "$d/components"
grep -Fx bundled-python3-unix "$d/components"
notes: Converts the official sdk.cloud.google.com bootstrap and its install_google_cloud_sdk.bash child. Both hosted originals are fetched at build time with pinned SHA-256 values. Only minimal call anchors are published for these bootstrap stages; changed bytes require reanalysis.

The bootstrap download selects the official complete versioned Linux x86_64 archive instead of the seed archive that would fetch components online. Preserves extraction, overwrite rejection, the archive install.sh and its unmodified Python initialization, official PATH updates and Bash completion.

The archive install.sh is retained as an audited source snapshot in scripts/provenance. The extracted original is checked against that exact source digest and executed in place without adding offline-lib.sh to the installed copy. Its reviewed Python initializer uses the native file:// component snapshot override; no downstream online installer is skipped.

For the upstream noninteractive prompt branch, use Bash printf -v to assign the supplied default directory literally before the interactive eval-based expansion. This preserves dollar signs, repeated spaces and command-like characters in explicit paths; the original interactive branch remains intact.

The full archive includes Python 3.14.9, bq and gsutil. No system Python or pip download is needed. The versioned official components-v592.0.0.json is bundled and supplied through the native component_manager/snapshot_url file:// override for installer component listing.

Normal installation retains the upstream refusal to overwrite an existing google-cloud-sdk directory. Explicit --reinitialize verifies the exact installed version and reruns the official archive installer for repeat initialization; it does not delete an existing installation.

Tests bundled Python ssl/sqlite3, gcloud/bq/gsutil versions, offline component listing, local project/logging configuration, and official profile/completion activation. Cloud login, API requests and extra components are outside scope.

Ubuntu 22.04 x86_64 glibc test baseline. The archived Google Cloud CLI LICENSE declares Apache-2.0 unless an alternate license applies; its included Python and third-party dependency notices remain in the original archive.

validation_scope.userspace: Ubuntu 22.04 prepared image; Python comes from the official CLI archive
validation_scope.runtime_scope: CLI archive installer, bundled Python, profile/completion and local configuration; no cloud account
